**Proof.**

Define $Q(X) = P(X) - X$. Since $P$ is monic of degree 2020, and subtracting the degree-1 polynomial $X$ does not affect the leading term, $Q$ is also monic of degree 2020.

For each $n \in \{0, 1, \ldots, 2019\}$, we have $P(n) = n$, hence
$$Q(n) = P(n) - n = 0.$$
So $Q$ has the 2020 distinct roots $0, 1, 2, \ldots, 2019$.

Since $Q$ is monic of degree 2020 and has exactly these 2020 roots (counting multiplicity, the total number of roots equals the degree), we conclude
$$Q(X) = X(X-1)(X-2)\cdots(X-2019).$$

Therefore
$$P(X) = X + X(X-1)(X-2)\cdots(X-2019).$$

Evaluating at $X = 2020$:
$$P(2020) = 2020 + 2020 \cdot 2019 \cdot 2018 \cdots 1 = 2020 + 2020!.$$

$$\boxed{P(2020) = 2020 + 2020!}$$

### PROOF COMPLETE
